name: Register a camera
title: Register a camera
description:
Create the physical camera record after its area and type exist. Enter a stable camera name, active status, type, operational area, installation/serial identifiers where appropriate, and exact latitude/longitude. Add address and jurisdiction/boundary links only when supported by your source. Record location source and confidence; resolve ambiguous lookups instead of treating a guess as verified.

Connectivity fields can reveal infrastructure; follow your access policy. Store account secrets only in the restricted Access Credentials tab, never in free-text descriptions or notes. Add a main image only when authorized and useful. Save, reopen, and verify the marker, coverage, location snapshots, and related area on the Camera Archive Map.
